title: Customers charged twice on slow networks
description: Several customers were charged twice for one order, mostly on mobile connections.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Root cause: the app retried the payment request after a timeout without an idempotency key, so the provider processed both requests.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Fixed by generating an idempotency key on the server for each cart and sending it with every payment attempt, so a retry returns the first result.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Disabling the pay button after the first tap was suggested but we rejected it as the only fix because the mobile app also retries in the background.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Gotcha: the key must be tied to the cart contents. If the cart changes, create a new key, otherwise the provider rejects the changed amount.
